title: I Developera free VRhorror game for Quest 3 – Forbidden SILENVIL Demo
author: iQoxi
selftext:
Hi everyone, I’m the solo developer behind **Forbidden SILENVIL Demo**.

I working on this Quest 3 horror project for quite a while, and the free demo is finally live on the Meta Horizon Store.

One of the main things I wanted to do differently was make the player actually perform parts of the ritual instead of just pressing a button. You have to **speak ritual phrases into the headset microphone**, interact physically with the environment, and progress through the horror that way.I really appreciate honest feedback, especially about the atmosphere, controls, voice mechanic and scares. I’m still developing the full game, so criticism is genuinely useful.

Meta Quest Store:  
[https://www.meta.com/experiences/app/1352349111291709/](https://www.meta.com/experiences/app/1352349111291709/)

If anyone tries it, let me know what worked and what didn’t.
